Solution.S:
Given $y = a x^{n+1} + b x^{-n}$.

First derivative:
$$\frac{dy}{dx} = a(n+1)x^{n} + b(-n)x^{-n-1} = a(n+1)x^n - b n x^{-n-1}.$$

Second derivative:
$$\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = a(n+1)n x^{n-1} - b n (-n-1) x^{-n-2} = a n(n+1) x^{n-1} + b n (n+1) x^{-n-2}.$$

Factor $n(n+1)$:
$$\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = n(n+1) \left( a x^{n-1} + b x^{-n-2} \right) = n(n+1) \cdot \frac{a x^{n+1} + b x^{-n}}{x^2} = \frac{n(n+1)}{x^2} y.$$

Therefore,
$$x^2 \frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = n(n+1) y.$$

Hence the correct option is C.
